summary.one_liner: MiniAGI is a minimal autonomous agent for GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4 that uses a robust prompt, a small tool set, chain-of-thought, and summarizing short-term memory to carry out tasks given in plain language.
summary.what_it_does: The agent takes a natural-language objective from the command line (python miniagi.py "..."), then plans and runs steps using a minimal set of tools. The README names commands such as execute_python, execute_shell, read_file, web_search, ingest_data and process_data. It keeps short-term memory with summarization and supports inner monologue and self-criticism. An optional critic (ENABLE_CRITIC=true) can improve accuracy at the cost of extra API requests. Web search defaults to DuckDuckGo, and can be switched to Parallel Search MCP or disabled with SEARCH_PROVIDER. The README includes many example transcripts, such as drawing an image, building a website, a Snake game, a Bitcoin EMA analysis, and a penetration test. It warns that the agent may suggest harmful commands and may send data to third-party API providers such as OpenAI. A PROMPT_USER confirmation step is mentioned, where the user can press enter to approve an action or type feedback to abort.
use_cases: autonomous task execution from a single prompt
generating and running Python scripts to create files or images
data analysis of local CSV files
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (the README leaves the URL blank)
notable: Minimal tool set combined with chain-of-thought and summarizing short-term memory
Optional self-critic step controlled by ENABLE_CRITIC
Configurable web search provider: DuckDuckGo, Parallel, or none
Per-action confirmation prompt that lets the user abort with feedback
caveats: The README warns the agent may suggest harmful commands or code and should be used with caution.
Data may be shared with third-party API providers such as OpenAI, depending on settings.
Parallel search free usage is rate limited, and it has a 30-second socket timeout.
keywords: ai that writes and runs code
